entry_points.text: Poll and dispatch. Arrival counts and schedules NAPI; receive disables callbacks, reclaims transmit, ingests to budget, completes below budget with moderation; transmit reclaims and wakes on space; dispatch validates length, syncs DMA, saves flags, routes to mergeable, large or small, refill posts one.

Transmit and wakeup. Transmit picks queue, reclaims or suspends, timestamps, builds descriptors with drop on failure, enforces full control and notify; wakeup rejects down or bad index, nudges transmit, receive or both.

Open and filters. Open prefills receives, enables pairs, sets carrier and notices with unwind; worker programs promiscuous, all-multicast and tables async; VLAN add or delete commands, warns on failure but succeeds.

exports.text: Premapped single insertion. Output forwards device token and context, input forwards host token plus extra; common inserts one descriptor without mapping.
Ring sizing, DMA and affinity. Size tracks packed or split, DMA only with mapping API, resize rejects over-max and empty and no-ops when same, affinity delegates or succeeds.
Config notice gating. Disable suppresses callbacks, enable clears and delivers at most one deferred change.

hazards.text: Peer frames. Short, truncated or oversize and missing segments occur; short and missing are length errors, oversize dropped, partial cleaned with drop counting, no use after free.
Allocation and races. Split exhaustion, release chains or pools cleanly, keep rescheduling; schedule after enable for early completions, loop re-arm stable, wake with space under lock.
Control hazards. Busy-waits, assumes features and bounds; descriptor failure warns and drops, filter and VLAN only warn; backend may resize on error, re-query size.

ABI. Wakeup splits directions; verdicts pass, transmit, redirect, drop with middle two suppressing; partial drops; offload none, TCP, UDP plus ECN with flags in device order; features gate speed, link, length, coalescing, tunnels, modes, memory, queues, layout; commands MAC, VLAN, filters, queues, RSS, link with success.

invariants.text: Refill and intake. Prefers XSK then loops to exhaustion, notifies, splits exhaustion; small encodes capacity, big chains with header isolated, mergeable clamps; intake bounds by budget, stats under seq, refills past half budget or ring, forces reschedule on failure.

NAPI, pairs, pools, moderation. Enable then BH schedule for early completions, transmit needs weight and hint; pair registers XDP, picks memory, enables with unwind; pools skipped for large, else one per pair from ring, DMA when offered; moderation samples with packets, cancel needs coalescing.

Transmit headers. Validates tunnels, handles mergeable count, inlines or separates by alignment and headroom; maps TCP families and UDP with ECN, rejects unknown, encodes checksums with VLAN fix; tunnel zeroes hash, masks types, derives offsets; lengths from transport plus upper in device order.

Config and layout. Link gated on speed duplex with validation; read is sleepable, type-checked, narrow single and wide repeated with endian swap; packed covers both orders; driver conversion links callbacks.

Control, MAC, RSS, stats. Needs control queue, builds bounded descriptors, queues, notifies, polls, judges by status; MAC prefers command else legacy; stats sum per-pair under seq plus device; queue updates RSS or count with trailer sync; RSS pairs header and trailer; affinity clears when hinted.

XSK, headroom, frags. Cookie is length shifted by flag plus transmit tag; headroom only with programs, programs drop offload and partial, mergeable needs headroom and frag support; coalescing drains with guards, fallback single copy; release returns pages, conversion carves length with metadata and frags.

locks.text: Locking. Reclaim under try or full lock; reset and stop or wake under TX BH; control under mutex; config under IRQ spin; program under RCU; stats under seq with IRQ variant; post-enable schedule under BH.

state_machines.text: Zero-copy transmit. Reclaims silently, retires completions, batches by free slots, submits singly with tail completion on failure, one doorbell, skips full only for raw, updates time, seq stats and wakeup; signals if any left.

Small and large receive. Small strips pad and headroom, checks length with overlong errors, runs program with pass rebuild or transmit or redirect suppress or drop, else copies header recyclable; large validates budget, wraps paged, drops to pool on failure.

Mergeable receive. Count from header, first validated, program when enabled else head plus chain with estimator; program excludes headroom and header, checks frag max, appends with sync; pass builds recyclable, transmit or redirect suppress, else release, drain and count drops.

Config deferral and resize. Off or disabled sets pending, re-enable clears and delivers one; resize drains via recycle, runs completion, changes backend, re-enables, prefers re-enable failure, needs transport, busy on failure.

Pause, resize, close. Receive pause halts polling and moderation when running, resume prefills and enables, resize stages, pauses, resizes and resumes; transmit pause marks reset and stops locked, resume clears and wakes, resize rejects small then cycles; close suppresses, cancels, disables pairs, clears carrier.

structs.text: Queues, headers, filters. Send and receive hold virtqueue, NAPI, stats, pool, moderation, XSK, estimator, scatter; device tracks pairs and modes; config enabled, disabled, pending, lock; mergeable, frags and program expose counts and pointers; MAC packs unicast then multicast.
